passives.name: Reactive Armor
passives.description: (Passive Effect) If the caster is not inflicted with a debuff when hit, reduces Weakness Gauge damage taken by [Buff_V_4076006_11_3]. If the hit was non-critical, reduces the cooldown of Guardian Cannon by [Buff_V_4076006_11_2] turn(s). Increases damage dealt to non-Water enemies and reduces damage taken from them. Reduces damage dealt to Water enemies and increases damage taken from them.
